question: Do role-preserving pairs carry more transferable information in operator/port/arity structure than in residual geometric realization?

model.standardization: train means and population standard deviations only
model.classifier: deterministic class-balanced logistic regression implemented in-script
model.selection: none; feature families frozen before fit

falsifier: If the typed feature family fails either independent-lane AUC gate or does not beat the geometry comparator in both lanes, operator/port/arity is not supported as the stronger transferable representation by this test.
claimBoundary: A pass supports a transferable typed-structure predictor of already-frozen role preservation. It does not establish historical semantics or prove that junctions literally encode verbs or endpoints literal arguments.
